verdict.rationale: Cua is a hosted platform that handles user sessions and data, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a policy or control that keeps user data out of AI model training. End-to-end encrypted relay connections, item-level access approvals and running Spaces on your own machines are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
